mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, binding_id, target_type, target_id, kb_id, profile_id, priority, required, max_tokens, status, revision, metadata, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM rag_agent_binding WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId} AND status = 'active' AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY priority ASC, id ASC
